site_name: CyrusOne San Antonio SAT2-SAT4 campus (San Antonio II), 9554 Westover Hills Blvd, San Antonio TX 78251
year_site_match: CyrusOne's FY2015 10-K names the facility "Westover Hills Blvd. (San Antonio 2)"; the FY2016 10-K lists "San Antonio II" in the operating Data Center Portfolio. The TDLR record at 9554 Westover Hills (owner contains CyrusOne, name indicates SAT Building 3, new construction 5/1/2016 to 1/1/2017, Project Closed) ties that address to the same campus, and matches the 10-K's San Antonio III under development with 1Q'17 completion. Hosting Journalist (2015-03-20) says San Antonio II is "located in the Westover Hills area."
verification: The pages support 2016, NOT the claimed 2014. Bisnow (2014-11-17) does say "The firm just completed its second San Antonio building," but it names no address or facility, and CyrusOne's own SEC filings contradict reading that as operating. FY2014 10-K (filed 2015-02-27): San Antonio 2 appears only in the "NRSF Under Development" table as of Dec 31, 2014 (estimated costs to completion $14-17M) and not in the operating portfolio, which lists only San Antonio 1. FY2015 10-K (filed 2016-02-26): still only in "NRSF Under Development As of December 31, 2015", row reads "Westover Hills Blvd. (San Antonio 2) San Antonio 3Q'16 30,000 20,000 25,000 49,000 124,000 3.0 32 8-11 40-43". FY2016 10-K (filed 2017-02-24): San Antonio II is in the operating Data Center Portfolio as of Dec 31, 2016, 64,221 CSF, 100% leased. Bracket: not operating at 2015-12-31, operating at 2016-12-31, exactly one year apart, so 2016 at medium. Inference, not stated on a page: the 2014 "completed" most likely referred to the building shell. Caveats: I read only the first ~100k characters of each 10-K (Item 1 portfolio tables; no narrative sentence about San Antonio 2 found in the parts read); table rows were flattened from cells by the fetch tool, so the quote is cell values joined by spaces; the TDLR address/owner fields were confirmed by yes/no answers from the fetch tool rather than printed verbatim. Hosting Journalist (2015-03-20) describes a virtual tour and uses future tense ("will be connected"), and does not say the site was open. Business Wire originals not attempted (researcher reported 403); a DCD guess URL returned 403.

site_name: CyrusOne Austin III (AUS3), Met Center, 7100 Metropolis Dr, Austin TX 78744
year_evidence_quote: CyrusOne has brought online the first phase of its third data center in Austin.
year_site_match: The article describes CyrusOne's third Austin data center (phase one 55,000 sq ft colo, 3 MW; 120,000 sq ft and 18 MW at full build), matching Commercial Property Executive's (2016-07-04) Austin III "housed in Austin's Met Center" with the same 120,000 CSF / 18 MW full-build figures. CyrusOne's FY2015 10-K lists "Metropolis Dr., Austin, TX (Austin 3)" in the operating portfolio as of Dec 31, 2015 (61,838 CSF, 3 MW); it is absent from both FY2014 10-K tables. The TDLR record TABS2022009611 has a location address containing "7100 Metropolis", owner containing CyrusOne, facility name containing "Austin Met III".
verification: Claimed year 2015 confirmed. Data Center Knowledge, dated December 15, 2015, states outright that phase one was brought online. The DCK article itself does not print the street address or "Met Center"; the tie to 7100 Metropolis Dr rests on (i) "third data center in Austin" = Austin III, (ii) CyrusOne's FY2015 10-K showing Austin 3 on Metropolis Dr. operating at 2015-12-31 and not listed at 2014-12-31, and (iii) the TDLR record at 7100 Metropolis for "Austin Met III" (renovation, 4/1/2022 to 9/1/2022, Project Closed; a later alteration, not the opening). TDLR address/owner/facility fields were confirmed by yes/no answers from the fetch tool rather than printed verbatim. The Commercial Property Executive piece (2016-07-04) reports completion of the 172,000 sq ft facility, a later milestone than first operation. CyrusOne's current AUS2-AUS3 page gives no opening year.
